findings.title: Context signUp returns Promise<void> while auth.ts signUp returns Promise<User>
findings.where: ## AccountContext refactor (context value type) vs. ### users.ts and auth.ts — module surfaces
findings.problem: Two different signUp functions with different return types are never explicitly contrasted in one place, so a hurried reader could mistake one for a typo.
findings.fix: Add one clause where the context delegates: the context's signUp returns Promise<void> and ignores the User returned by auth.signUp because onAuthStateChanged populates account.

findings.title: Firestore modular imports for listReviews ordering implied but not named
findings.problem: The exact modular imports (collection, query, orderBy, getDocs, addDoc, serverTimestamp) are left to inference. This matches the abstraction level of favorites.ts/tasks.ts, so it is uniform and acceptable, not a reviews-specific gap.
findings.fix: Optional: list 'collection, query, orderBy, getDocs, addDoc, serverTimestamp from firebase/firestore' for parity with the explicit auth import guidance; confirm paths against the installed SDK per NFR-7.
